findings.text: The normal form assumes `compareValues` distinguishes different values, but integer `1` and real `1.0` compare equal, so sorting can preserve different permutations of the same rows. Fix: require a deterministic tie-breaker that distinguishes storage classes and payloads when normalizing results.

The document assumes predictions run the native-output comparison, but `Predict.lean` only emits outputs and `judge/outputs.py` compares them, so changes to `Case.lean` cannot enforce list membership in the verdict. Fix: specify a replay and kernel-proof check, or plan a separately approved judge change to enforce membership in the verdict.
The file list places `Query.runOn` in `Subqueries.lean`, but its definition is in `Execution.lean`. Fix: correct the file reference to `Execution.lean`.
